cover_letter:
Dear Harbourline Media team,

I am a third-year Computing student at Liffey Institute of Technology and I would like to apply for your summer Software Development Internship.

I have built several small web projects with React, including a group project where I developed the frontend for a study-matching app. I care a lot about accessibility; I first got interested in it when a friend who uses a screen reader showed me how hard many websites are for her to use.

I read your news site every day and I would love to help make it faster and easier to use for everyone. I am a quick learner and I am used to working hard - I have worked as a barista part-time throughout college.

Thank you for considering my application.

Yours sincerely,
Aiyana Brooks-Tan
